shadow_book.question: When I said TOO_LATE, was skipping it correct at +90d against SPY?
shadow_book.source: data/shadow/results.json (Actions prices the rows; I only read them)

entry_zones.question: Did price ever reach the zones I drew, and what happened after?
entry_zones.note: A zone price never reached is a miss with better manners. A zone that filled instantly was not a zone.

red_team_amendments.question: How often does my own attack change my draft, and which attack lands?
red_team_amendments.note: An attack dimension that has never amended anything is either unnecessary or being performed rather than run. Naming which is part of the report.

implied_growth.question: The market-implied CAGR I recorded at dive time, against what was actually delivered by review_by.
implied_growth.note: This grades the reverse DCF itself. Without it the gap table is a format, not a method.
